description: bits-ui's Avatar compiled from its published source (its root state holds svelte-toolbelt's DOMContext and binds an image loader) through shadcn-svelte's unmodified avatar wrappers, arranged as the avatar demos arrange them but without Avatar.Image: loading an image is rejected (the native runtime fetches no images and renders no ; new Image() throws RunicUnsupportedError when it runs; every avatar demo loads one from github.com and is rejected), so the avatars show their fallbacks with data-status loading, as the demos do while their images load. Sizes changed from the app (data-size and the size-dependent classes), a badge, a group with a count
